transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, work actually sent me. I guess I've just been... forgetting things lately. Like work orders and scheduled callbacks. Just basic follow-ups I told people I'd do. It's kind of piled up on me, and... they said I needed to come here and get it sorted out before I lose my shot at moving up.
Has this kind of forgetfulness and trouble following through on tasks been something you've dealt with since childhood, or is this a new change for you recently?

Um... no, it's not new. I guess it's always been like this. 

Even back in... grade school, long before any of this job stuff. My teachers used to say I was bright, but... I don't know, I was always losing my papers. Or I'd miss parts of the directions. They always had to stay on me and remind me to just... finish my classwork. So, yeah. It's not a new thing.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling persistently sad, down, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
No. Um... not really. I mean, I'm not sad. Just... frustrated with the whole work situation, I guess. But no.
Do you often find yourself worrying excessively about various things—work, health, or other everyday matters—more than you feel you should, and have difficulty controlling that worry?
No, not really. I mean, I worry about getting fired because I keep messing up, but... I don't think it's excessive. It's just normal worrying.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety, have trouble sitting still, or find yourself interrupting others or acting impulsively without thinking it through?
No, I don't think so. I'm not really... restless. And I don't interrupt people. Just the focus stuff.
Do you notice this same kind of forgetfulness or trouble finishing tasks happening in other areas of your life too, like at home or in personal errands, not just at work?
Yeah, I guess. It happens at home, too. I start fixing something, then... just sort of leave it half done. Or I forget to pick things up from the store. It's just... everywhere, really.
Do you find that you get easily distracted by things going on around you—like noises, conversations, or your phone—while you're trying to focus on a task?

Um... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed if it's... noises or anything like that. 

I just... lose my place. I don't really pay attention to what's going on around me, I just sort of... drift off, I guess.
